verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API with a full embedded OpenAPI 3.0 spec, resource-oriented endpoints, and a versioning policy, and says it can 'connect to any existing object' in an account. A first-party MCP server also lets clients query and update controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, and risks. That is broad programmatic access, but nothing states the API matches the UI, and many UI workflows have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, documented API coverage of UI workflows such as Trust Center configuration, policy editing, access-review decisions, and Comply AI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage.
